reviews.title: Crashes when deleting or uploading or downloading
reviews.text: This needs to be fixed. It’s a recent problem. I will change my review once fixed.

reviews.title: I have it on my iPad and it keeps crashing and closing.
reviews.text: The app repeatedly crashes if you try to change the name if you try to upload if you try to share it, it just keeps closing

reviews.title: It crashes when trying to upload
reviews.text: I have used the free version for a while, and it was working just fine until it started crashing every time I tried to upload a downloaded file. It crash every time I make an attempt. So I proceeded to see if the paid version was better, but the exact same issue. I would like an update to fix that issue. This this is one of the simplest, best download app I’ve recently gotten, but now it’s just completely useless. If not fixed, I would just resort to a refund instead.
